subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram Channel: Support Thread Binding for Subagent Sessions

question: Should Telegram expose explicit child forum-topic subagent session spawns for `sessions_spawn(thread:true, mode:"session")`, or should Telegram remain current-topic only by default?
rationale: Current main has both a current-topic default and child-topic binding primitives, while related open work argues both for topic-per-subagent workflows and against user-visible internal subagent topic proliferation.

options.title: Approve explicit child-topic spawn
options.body: Sponsor a narrow core session-binding capability that exposes deliberate Telegram subagent child forum topics while keeping ordinary Telegram placement current-topic.

options.title: Keep Telegram current-topic only
options.body: Reject user-visible child-topic subagent spawning for now and close or redirect the open implementation candidate accordingly.

options.title: Defer to broader policy
options.body: Block this issue on the broader channel threading policy work before deciding Telegram-specific exposure.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit child-topic spawn
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow core session-binding capability that exposes deliberate Telegram subagent child forum topics while keeping ordinary Telegram placement current-topic.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice extends the core thread-binding architecture introduced by the merged core refactor.
